talent.title: Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights

desc.text:
<color=#ffd680>Elemental Skill</color>
Deal 1 <color=#99ff88>Dendro DMG</color> . Attach 1 stack of <color=#ffffff>RES</color> to self. Before your next action, grant <color=#ffffff>Cost Reduction</color> to up to 3 highest-cost <color=#ffffff>Seeds of Deceit</color> in your Hand.
<color=#ebe4d8>RES</color>
<color=#ffd680>Status</color>
<color=#ffffff>When the character to which this is attached takes DMG:</color> Decrease DMG taken by 1. (Can stack, no stack limit)

<color=#ffd680>Elemental Burst</color>
Deal 4 <color=#99ff88>Dendro DMG</color> . Deal +1 DMG for each <color=#ffffff>Seeds of Deceit</color> in your Hand (max +2)

<color=#ffd680>Event Card</color>
<color=#ffffff>Combat Action</color> : Can be used when Nefer is the active character.
Nefer uses the Skill: <color=#ffffff>Phantasm Performance</color> .
<color=#ebe4d8>Phantasm Performance</color>
<color=#ffd680>Normal Attack</color>
Deal 4 <color=#99ff88>Dendro DMG</color> .
Using this skill will not grant <color=#ffffff>Energy.</color>

<color=#ffd680>Passive Skill</color>
(Passive) During this game, when your opponent is affected by <color=#ffffff>Bloom reaction(s)</color> , the reaction will be converted to the <color=#ffffff>Lunar-Bloom</color> reaction.
<color=#ffffff>When your Hand contains fewer than 3 Seeds of Deceit and the opponent is affected by the Lunar-Bloom reaction:</color> Create 1 <color=#ffffff>Seeds of Deceit</color> in your Hand. (Twice per Round)

Applies Dendro and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
[ <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Bloom</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Dendro Core</color> ] that greants +2 DMG to the next instance of Pyro or Electro DMG
[ <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> + <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Burning</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Burning Flame</color> ] that will deal 1 Pyro DMG at the end of the Round (Takes effect once, max 2 stacks)
[ <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Quicken</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Catalyzing Field</color> ] that grants +1 DMG to the next 2 instances of Dendro or Electro DMG
[ <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Lunar</color> <color=#ffffff>Bloom</color> : Deal +1 DMG for this instance, and apply [ <color=#ffffff>Cost Reduction</color> ] to a random card in your Hand

<color=#ebe4d8>Combat Action</color>
After you finish 1 Combat Action, it will be your opponent's turn.
<color=#ffffff>Playing a card from your Hand with this rule is also a Combat Action rather than a Fast Action</color> .
<color=#ece5d8>Cost Reduction</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Every stack makes playing this card cost 1 fewer Elemental Die. (Can stack, no stack limit)</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Lunar-Bloom</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deal +1 DMG for this instance, and apply [</color> <color=#ffffff>Cost Reduction</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] to a random card in your Hand.</color>

customize.name: Lucky Coin
customize.desc: Currency verified and used by the Genius Invokation TCG Society. Can be used to purchase various items related to Genius Invokation TCG. It is said that these coins were initially named as such in the hopes that they would bring those carrying them luck. However, perhaps it is those who are sufficiently lucky who are able to possess them...
